cost_entries_scope_target_check.name: cost_entries_scope_target_check
cost_entries_scope_target_check.value: ("cost_entries"."scope" = 'receipt' AND "cost_entries"."receipt_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("cost_entries"."scope" = 'batch' AND "cost_entries"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("cost_entries"."scope" = 'crate' AND "cost_entries"."crate_id" IS NOT NULL)

handovers_target_check.name: handovers_target_check
handovers_target_check.value: ("handovers"."kind" = 'returned_to_sender' AND "handovers"."receipt_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("handovers"."kind" = 'issued_to_client' AND "handovers"."client_id" IS NOT NULL)

scan_events_target_check.name: scan_events_target_check
scan_events_target_check.value: ("scan_events"."type" = 'issue') = ("scan_events"."handover_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("scan_events"."type" <> 'issue') = ("scan_events"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL)
